title: MI-177: fleet-wide journal-open vs venue audit — 8/11 accounts read, 24/25 exact, 1 known divergence
body:
**Tier 1 · MEASURE ONLY.** Nothing closed, cancelled, repaired, re-armed or reconciled. No order-path code touched. The diff is one evidence document, its index row, two backlog rows, and the landing declaration.

This is the standing pipeline lane's own next step, **named by MI-166 and never done**: *"journal-open vs `exchange_positions` audit across all accounts."* Every journal-vs-venue divergence this system has ever found was found by accident, while someone was looking at something else. **The question had never been asked fleet-wide.**

⚠️ **Could not post the mandatory START claim** — coordination board #6927 is at GitHub's hard 2500-comment cap; writes 403 and reads return a board frozen at 2026-09-07T11:28:17Z. Known and parked; not retried.

## Verdict

Of **11 declared accounts**, **8 were readable on both sides**. Across those 8, **25 symbol pairs** were compared: **24 reconcile exactly, 1 diverges.** Three accounts were not readable on the venue side and are reported as *not looked at* — never as clean.

### Real money first

| account | venue read_state | result |
|---|---|---|
| `bybit_2` | READ | **exact** — ETHUSDT 0.04 = 0.04, XRPUSDT 58.5 = 58.5 |
| `alpaca_live` | READ | **exact** — flat both sides; uncapped journal read confirms 0 open rows |
| `ib_live` | **NOT READ** (`mode: dry_run` — the IB branch never dials a dry account) | **UNKNOWN — not clean** |

**Neither readable real-money account diverges.**

### The one divergence — already owned, not re-filed

`ib_paper` **MGC**: journal **54** (trades 5353 = 11, 5531 = 43) against venue **11**, divergence **+43**. Reproduced on two independent reads six minutes apart. This is exactly the case `WO-20260907-ROOT-CAUSE-THE-43-PHANTOM-MGC-LOTS` owns — checked with `backlog_search.py` and **deliberately not re-filed**.

**It also answers that work object's open sub-question** — *"whether the same class touches `bybit_2` or `alpaca_live` (both REAL MONEY — this outranks the MGC root cause if yes)"*. **Measured answer: no.** The MGC root cause is not outranked.

## Read states — the three accounts nobody looked at

`positions: null` means *could-not-read* per the route's own docstring. All three arrived with `error: null`, so the response itself does not distinguish them; the reasons were read from `account_open_positions`.

| account | money | why not read | resolves on its own? |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ib_live` | **REAL MONEY** | `mode: dry_run` — dry-mode gate | yes, on promotion to live |
| `oanda_practice` | paper | `mode: dry_run` — same gate | yes, on promotion to live |
| `breakout_1` | **PROP, `mode: live`** | `exchange: breakout` is not one of the four supported exchanges | **no — no read path exists** |

## Positive control

Three known divergences existed to test the probe against:

1. **MGC — FOUND** (above). The probe discriminates.
2. **Bybit SOLUSDT 451× — NOT TESTABLE TODAY**: no account holds an open SOLUSDT position on either side. Not counted as a control.
3. **`alpaca_portfolio`/TLT — FOUND, but not as a divergence.** See below.

## The blind spot, stated explicitly

**A per-symbol sum cannot see the defect MI-173 found.** `alpaca_portfolio` TLT is two journal rows — 5266 (`tlt_pullback_1d`, 16) and 5414 (`tlt_pullback_1h`, 56) — against one venue position of 72 short. They sum to exactly 72, so this audit reports it **exact**, and would report it exact however the 72 were split. Four symbols across three accounts carry this multi-row-to-one-venue-position packing: `ib_paper` MGC, `alpaca_portfolio` TLT, `bybit_1` ADAUSDT and AVAXUSDT.

**"24 of 25 exact" must not be read as "per-trade attribution is correct."** It says the *quantities* agree.

## The methodological finding — this audit nearly filed four FALSE positives

`/api/diag/journal?table=trades` is `ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT <=1000` over a **5545-row** table, so the reachable window was ids 4546–5545 and **4 of the 29 open rows fell below it**: 4194 (`alpaca_paper` IEF 141), 4195 (`alpaca_portfolio` IEF 152), 4347 (`alpaca_paper` SPY 11), 4350 (`ib_paper` MES 15) — all opened 2026-07-29 … 08-03.

Read off `/api/diag/journal` alone, those four present as *"the venue holds a position the journal has no row for"* — **four phantom-position divergences that do not exist**, two of them on the same accounts as real findings.

They were caught by not trusting either surface alone: open rows were re-read from `/api/bot/positions` (which queries `WHERE status='open'` with no id window), then cross-checked against `RiskManager._open_gross_notional_from_db` — an **uncapped** `SUM(ABS(position_size*entry_price))` served per account by `/api/diag/exposure`. **The two agree to the cent on all 9 accounts where exposure is measurable.** That agreement, not any single route's say-so, is what makes "journal read state = complete" an assertion rather than a hope.

## Two new findings filed (both `backlog_search`-checked first)

- **`BL-20260908-BOT-POSITIONS-SILENTLY-CAPS-AT-50-OPEN-ROWS-AND-THE-FLEET-IS-AT-29`** (high) — `/api/bot/positions` has a hardcoded `LIMIT 50` (`src/web/api/routers/dashboard.py:770`) with no total, no truncation flag and no limit param. Measured 29/50 today, so truncation was **not** exercised and is **not** claimed as observed: the cap is read from code, the 29 is measured. This is a **second confirmed member** of the population `BL-20260906-TRADES-CLOSED-SILENTLY-RETURNS-EMPTY-ABOVE-LIMIT-200-AND-FOR-ANY-SINCE` explicitly asks to be swept (`notifications.py:336` LIMIT 25 and `:403` LIMIT 50 remain unexamined candidates).
- **`BL-20260908-THREE-OF-ELEVEN-ACCOUNTS-HAVE-NO-VENUE-POSITION-READ-AND-BREAKOUT-1-CAN-NEVER-HAVE-ONE`** (medium) — `breakout_1` is prop, `mode: live`, and not dormant (41 `prop_fills`, 91 `prop_tickets`); its venue state is unreadable by construction.

- Backlog appended through `scripts/ops/backlog_append.py`: **24 insertions, 0 deletions** — no reformat, no re-attribution.
